department: Department of Astrophysics (PhD programs in Theoretical Astrophysics and Cosmology; Computational Science)

deadline.value: No central call: apply to open positions or contact group leaders; then enrol through the UZH Admissions Office.

supervisor.value: A group leader must accept you; a signed Confirmation of Supervision is needed for admission.
supervisor.quote: Please note that the 2 documents needed for the admission (Confirmation of Supervision / Acceptance Confirmation) will be created and sent to you by the HR representative of the Department as soon as possible.

funding.value: PhD students are generally employed at 80%, so they are salaried.

entry_route.value: A Master's degree in physics, astronomy or a related field is expected.
entry_route.quote: A Master's degree (or equivalent) in physics, astronomy, or a related field.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Same department also runs the PhD Program in Computational Science.
